mover_claims.claim: Noting that many small retailers do not yet have the systems needed to comply with the bill's proposed timeframe
mover_claims.evidence: many small retailers still lack the technical systems needed to comply with the proposed timeframe
mover_claims.speaker: Priya Nakamura

mover_claims.claim: Arguing consumers should be given more time before new data-sharing obligations begin
mover_claims.evidence: consumers should be given a longer transition period before new data-sharing obligations take effect
mover_claims.speaker: Priya Nakamura

mover_claims.claim: Warning the bill would add compliance costs for regional businesses without any support package
mover_claims.evidence: the bill, in its current form, would place additional compliance costs on regional businesses without a corresponding support package
mover_claims.speaker: Priya Nakamura

motion_text:
That all words after "whilst" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:

"declining to give the bill a second reading, the House also notes that:

(1) many small retailers still lack the technical systems needed to comply with the proposed timeframe;

(2) consumers should be given a longer transition period before new data-sharing obligations take effect; and

(3) the bill, in its current form, would place additional compliance costs on regional businesses without a corresponding support package".
